title: A new ending. (I wrote this a response elsewhere but wanted to share)
content: Just this week, for the first time, I reached what I would call "the end" of the world. I'm 49. I've been here since late teens. Fought many battles and seen many areas. Hills, deserts, beaches, islands, grassy canyons with rivers at the base .. Dark suburbia with wet roads and the threat of floods through the hilly terrain. Hotels on the edge of cliffs over beaches.. often they collapse into the water, and I have to escape the falling building as it crumbles around me.. Anyways, this time, a metro train appeared, that I've never seen before. A new addition as such. I boarded it with some excitement. It took me to the edge of the suburbs and morphed into these multiple country train lines, then, once out of the country areas it morphed again into almost a roller coaster type thing - lots of colours and tracks everywhere, really dream like and not reality like.. eventually 100's of metres in the air and swirling around and back down to a new island place I've never seen before. Well, this island was full of cemeteries and dead people who were waiting for something to 'happen'. I talked with a few but then we all had to play dead. Pretend we were asleep as this 'monster' walked amongst us checking we were dead/ asleep. Even tho my eyes were closed, he sent a bird to look me in the eyes, and the bird could tell I was really awake - it looked into my mind and I had to wake myself up to escape its gaze .. I can still see that picture many days later. Me with this bird starring at my face, knowing I'm pretending and about to alert its owner... the monster thing.. Everyone else there was literally the walking dead. This has never happened before. And now I have acces to this area should I choose. So last night I went there again, and it was even stranger. So many dead people doing 'life' things ... I now feel like I know a bit more about the reality of the shared place. And it's as odd as u might expect. It's definitely a shared space. Ps. The bird has been in my Minds eye for days after this dream. Sometimes he's black like a crow, and then others he's blue, with glasses and a top hat ffs.... when it was staring at me, I had my eyes closed, but could 'see' it with my third eye/ minds eye through my 'closed' eyes - that's how it new I was watching it back, and hence 'cheating' in that world, and it was so uncomfortable I had to wake myself.
